headline: NVIDIA documents NVKE Kubernetes AI conformance testing on two GB200 workers
summary: NVIDIA's AICR v1.2.0 release includes an NVKE GB200 training/Kubeflow recipe and publishes a Kubernetes v1.36 AI conformance submission. In the linked submission, NVIDIA says it collected evidence on Oct 27–28, 2026 using NVKE v0.22.0 and Kubernetes v1.36.3 on two ARM64 GB200 workers with eight GPUs. The results matrix marks seven applicable MUST requirements as passed and cluster autoscaling as not applicable under the operator-controlled scaling design. These are vendor-authored results for the described configuration; independent replay or external CNCF acceptance was not established in this review.
